title: Stephanie (Fanet) was...
text: Stephanie (Fanet) was very patient with us and excellent in communication. It was a great experience and would recommend.
author: Shahin_I

title: Absolutely must do in Granada
text: Somehow I was the only one who signed up for the sunset tour that day, really enjoyed my time Simon! Cycling is doable enough even in the steep slopes thanks to the mini tutorial given before it starts. The golden hues of the sunsetting overlooking the hills and mountains in Granada is breathtaking. This was an unplanned activity and I'm very thankful for it.
author: adakamal

title: Highly recommend!
text: Fun ride up and down cobblestone streets!  Our guide, originally from Hungary was fun, polite and very knowledgeable.  We saw places we would not have seen as walking tourists, with beautiful vistas.  Excellent and powerful e bikes.
author: Don_C

title: Quick but Pretty Cool
text: Had an excellent time.  Have taken a lot of bike tours but this was pretty unique.  Went to some off grid locations for views of the Alhambra and went on a challenging climb up some bumpy, windy roads in the Sacromonte. This gave some unique perspective on the caves and views but not things you'd see on foot.  Sadly the weather was gray but would go to some of the same places on a sunny day.
author: ESVoogd

title: Excellent ride with knowledgeable guide
text: This was a fantastic experience. Ruth my guide was very informative and took me to places that I would never have visited on my own. It was a thoroughly enjoyable 2 hours. The electric bike handled the inclines very well  - but you do need to know how to handle a bike. Some of the terrain is rough, steep  and also very narrow. I would recommend this tour highly - and Ruth was amazing !
author: PAUL_C

title: A top-notch activity to discover Granada and learn about its history
text:
Superb experience!! 
Great activity to discover another side of Granada.
Thanks to Fanette who was a very friendly and very knowledgeable guide!
author: 306delphineh

title: Full & Fun Day!
text:
Unforgettable way to see Granada! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our guide Simon was spectacular! Over 5+ hours, we got to see every corner of Granada, something we never could have done on foot. Simon organized two breaks along the way, one for a snack and one for lunch, and the food was great at both stops.

He was friendly, incredibly knowledgeable about the area, and attentive to our skill level on the bikes, giving us just the right amount of thrill throughout the day.

10/10, would highly recommend to anyone looking for a unique way to experience this beautiful city!
